Azadi vikas ka utprerak hai.
Zyada explore karo, kam worry karo, free jiyo.
Azaadi ek aadat hai, aur bhaari bhi, jo akeli sadko par milti hai.
Khushi thandi hai.
Pahad pure joy ke raaz fusfusate hain.
Duniya mein sirf ek hi joy hai – shuru karna.
Zyadatar log surakshit rehna chahte hain, par main azad rehna chahta hoon.
Pinjra chhodho, wildness ko gale lagao.
Joy divya pyar ki abhivyakti hai.
Happiness crunching gravel ki aawaz hai.
Khushi azadi mein phoolti hai.
Khushi aatma ki santushti hai.
Joy hone ka grace hai.
Khushi chamkili hai.
Khushi dimaag ka ek attitude hai, jo har halat mein khush rehne ki zid se paida hota hai.
Azaadi aatmanirbharta ka sabse bada phal hai.
Khushi hone ka shikhar hai.
Khushi santulan hai.
Khushi har jagah hai.
Khushi hamesha hai.
Azaadi adhunik samaj ka adhaar hai.
Khushi ek aadat hai jise koi nahi chura sakta.
Khushi awaaz hai.
Jahan apne vichar kehne ki azaadi na ho, wahan azaadi bematlab hai.
Azadi kabhi muft nahi hoti.
Khushi apne andar ke sath shanti mein rehna hai.
